 5.  Golf Course Manager' s Reports

  A.  General Manager Update Mr. Stevens reviewed the GM Update 2024 Q4
  report that included green fees, food and beverage, golf operation, tournaments,
  merchandize, range and cart fees. Winter maintenance was being conducted to
  prepare for Spring season.

  Mr. Stevens stated of additional signage was in progress to replace old signage in
  the parking lot, as well as the courtesy wall and safety railings by the oak tree for
  an additional venue for ceremonies and party options.

  Mr. Stevens requested if the water fund was available for the upcoming irrigation
  valves replacement project estimating cost of $68, 000,

  B.  Quarterly Financial Summary Report was read with 40 Quarter
  Generating a total of $ 1. 4 million, that included the following;

  154, 584 in tournament green fee -cart revenue
  499, 650 for private event revenue
  486, 300 Golf opslcafe food and beverage revenue

  C.  Banquet Room Update Mr. Bode stated the only pending item for the
  banquet completion is the ceremony site and the final plans approval still pending
  for final approval of the sail shades installations.

6.  New Business

  Mr. Wasserman presented for review and approval the proposed 2025 Capital
  Improvement Project list that included the following items;
  Replacement of the restrooms & septic tanks
  Installation  of club house signage

  Adding decorative up -lighting to the clubhouse trees and entrance
  Purchase of Model-T vehicle for shuttling at special events

  Mr. Bode added due to the current power outage that lasted for two days, and more
  are to be expected in the future, to consider adding to the list the purchase of a
  generator or solar wall panel in case of emergency.

  Mr. Domer recommended for staff to reach out to Edison for an energy audit to
  provide the best approach to what equipment best needed.

  Mr. Stevens proposed to include to the list for approval adding another $ 33, 000 to
  the up -lighting trees of the # 9 Fairway project that was already approved for the
  2024 year, due to the replacement of 3 pine trees due to beetle infections.
